template.constraints: Follow VPF journey brief: opt-in → Amount or Percentage → if Percentage, enter 1–12% → confirm. Each phase completes when the bot reaches the NEXT brief step, not final confirmation unless that phase says so.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: VPF opt in happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully opt into the Voluntary Provident Fund scheme

phases.completionCriteria: Bot has acknowledged VPF intent and asked for the contribution percentage or presented options
Bot has confirmed the VPF opt-in with the given percentage

variants.name: VPF opt out happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully opt out of the Voluntary Provident Fund scheme

phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the VPF opt-out

variants.name: VPF edge - invalid percentage
variants.goal: Verify the bot rejects an invalid VPF contribution percentage

phases.description: Initiate VPF opt-in until Amount/Percentage choice
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks Amount or Percentage for VPF contribution
Bot asks for VPF contribution percentage (1–12)

phases.description: Provide an invalid percentage (0% or over 100%)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the invalid percentage with an error message

phases.description: Provide a valid percentage and confirm
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the VPF opt-in

variants.name: VPF edge - over 100 percent rejected
variants.goal: Verify the bot rejects VPF contribution percentage over 100

phases.description: Initiate VPF opt-in until the percentage prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the VPF contribution percentage
Bot has rejected the percentage as invalid

phases.description: Provide a valid percentage and complete
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the VPF opt-in

variants.name: VPF edge - text instead of percentage
variants.goal: Verify the bot rejects non-numeric input where a percentage is expected

phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the contribution percentage

phases.description: Send text (e.g. 'five percent') instead of a number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the input and asks for a valid numeric percentage

phases.description: Provide a valid number and complete

variants.name: VPF edge - opt in already enrolled
variants.goal: Verify bot behaviour when user tries to opt into VPF but is already enrolled

phases.description: Try to opt into VPF — test account may already be enrolled
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either processes the opt-in, shows current enrollment, or warns user is already enrolled
